## Description

Provide a clear and concise summary of the changes made and the motivation behind them.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement / Refactoring

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style and guidelines of this project (`ruff check` and `ruff format --check`).
- [ ] I have added or updated tests covering my changes.
- [ ] All tests pass locally (`pytest`).
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly if applicable.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or private data are committed.
